title: CINeMA Exchange Schema v2
description: Schema for importing/exporting CINeMA (Confidence in Network Meta-Analysis) project data. Designed for interoperability with MetaInsight and other NMA software.

studies.description: Study arm-level data. Each element is one arm of one study.

analyses.description: Array of NMA analysis results. Each element is a complete, self-contained analysis (e.g. frequentist fixed-effect, Bayesian random-effects, data subset). Multiple analyses can coexist in one file.

stringOrInteger.description: A value that can be either a string or an integer. Mirrors PureScript TreatmentId = StringId String | IntId Int. When serialised as JSON the value may appear as a string ("ACE", "1") or a bare integer (1). Consumers should normalise by converting integers to strings for comparison.

comparisonId.description: Treatment comparison identifier. When both sides are strings: 'TreatA:TreatB' (alphabetically sorted). When treatments are numeric IDs the colon-separated form still applies (e.g. '1:2'). The JSON value is always a string.

study.description: Study label. Can be a string ('ALLHAT') or a numeric identifier (1). Mirrors PureScript TreatmentId.

id.description: Study identifier. Can be a string or integer. Must be consistent across arms of the same study.

treatment.description: Treatment name. Can be a string ('ACE') or a numeric identifier (1). Mirrors PureScript TreatmentId.

oneOf.description: Binary outcome: events required, mean/sd forbidden.
Continuous outcome: mean and sd required, events forbidden.

analysis.description: A complete NMA analysis result. Contains all computed quantities needed for CINeMA domain assessments.

nmaResults.description: Per-comparison NMA results. One entry per treatment comparison in the network.

pairwise.description: Per-direct-comparison pairwise meta-analysis heterogeneity statistics. Used by the Heterogeneity domain.

sensitivityLeagueTables.description: Sensitivity analysis league tables computed with study subsets filtered by RoB.

lowRoB.description: League table using only studies with rob=1 (Low).

lowModerateRoB.description: League table using studies with rob=1 or rob=2 (Low or Some concerns).

analysisParams.description: Parameters identifying this analysis. The tuple (model, sm, framework, tau) serves as the cache key.

tau.description: Heterogeneity standard deviation. 0 for fixed-effect models, estimated or user-specified for random-effects.

label.description: Human-readable label for this analysis (e.g. 'Frequentist Random-Effects OR, Full Dataset').

hatMatrix.description: The hat (projection) matrix H from NMA. H[i][j] gives the weight of direct comparison j in network estimate i.

H.description: 2D numeric matrix. Rows = all network comparisons, Columns = direct comparisons.

rowNames.description: Row labels for the H matrix (all network comparisons, format 'A:B').

colNames.description: Column labels for the H matrix (direct comparisons, format 'A:B').

comparisonResult.description: NMA results for a single treatment comparison. Contains the pooled network estimate, confidence/prediction intervals, and optionally the direct/indirect decomposition with SIDE incoherence test.

effect.description: Pooled NMA treatment effect (log-scale for ratio measures, original scale for difference measures).

se.description: Standard error of the NMA treatment effect.

ciLower.description: Lower bound of the 95% confidence interval.

ciUpper.description: Upper bound of the 95% confidence interval.

priLower.description: Lower bound of the 95% prediction interval.

priUpper.description: Upper bound of the 95% prediction interval.

propDirect.description: Proportion of direct evidence contribution to this NMA estimate (0 to 1).

direct.description: Direct evidence estimate and CI. Present only for comparisons with direct evidence.

indirect.description: Indirect evidence estimate and CI. Present only for comparisons with indirect evidence.

incoherence.description: SIDE (Separating Indirect from Direct Evidence) incoherence test. Present only for comparisons with both direct and indirect evidence.

effect.description: Incoherence factor (difference between direct and indirect estimates).

z.description: Z test statistic for the incoherence test.

pairwiseResult.description: Pairwise meta-analysis heterogeneity for a direct comparison.

Qoverall.description: Overall Q statistic for the network.

designByTreatment.description: Design-by-treatment interaction test for global network inconsistency. Used by the Incoherence domain for comparisons without direct evidence.

Q.description: Q statistic for the design-by-treatment interaction test.

studyContributions.description: Per-comparison, per-study percentage contributions. Keys are comparison IDs (e.g. 'A:B' or '1:2'). Values are objects mapping study identifiers to percentage contributions (0-100). Study keys can be names ('ALLHAT') or numeric string IDs ('1', '2') -- must match the studies[].study or studies[].id values when stringified.

^[a-zA-Z0-9_]+:[a-zA-Z0-9_]+$.description: Contributions for a single comparison. Keys are study identifiers (string or numeric-as-string), values are percentages summing to ~100.

leagueTable.description: League table matrix. A square matrix where diagonal cells contain treatment names, and off-diagonal cells contain formatted effect estimates with 95% CIs (e.g. '1.234 (0.567, 2.345)'). Row i vs column j gives the effect of treatment i relative to treatment j.
